{{Quote|Dena, do you have any maintenance scheduled for Crash Pit One?|Lando Calrissian, to Dena Yus|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
'''Crash Pit One''' was one of series of crash pits operated at the [[Sarnus Refinery]], an industrial complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]] owned by the businessman [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. The pit was used as a spot on which [[astrolith]]&mdash;crushed [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fragments [[The Drop (process)|dropped]] from the edge of [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Sarnus&mdash;were directed to land in Crash Pit One and the other pits and funnelled onto [[repulsi-veyer line]]s and transported to grinding mills for processing. In [[45 ABY]], the [[biot]] [[Dena Yus]] sabotaged Crash Pit One on behalf of the [[Columi/Legends|Columni]] industrialists [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] by misaligning the crash pit's protective [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]].<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Crash Pit One appeared in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
